name: Prasad Sir
player_statement:
A complete player, Prasad Sir has made a big mark in cricket. With 30 turns at the crease, they've hit a top score of 62*, with an average of 22.48 and a quick strike rate of 137.21. Their knack for hitting big shots is evident with 33 sixes and 18 fours.

Equally good at bowling, they've bowled 13.4 overs, taking 10 wickets at an economy rate of 5.71. Despite a few wides, their accuracy is top-notch, making them a key player for their team.
